summary: TOOL-1 Login with valid and invalid credentials
description:
As a customer, I want to sign in so I can access my account.

* Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
* Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
* Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.
* Password field masks the input.

criteria.text: Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.

cases.title: Sign in with valid email and password
cases.preconditions: A registered customer account exists with a known email and password. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the registered email in the email field.
Enter the correct password in the password field.
cases.expected: The user is redirected to the account page and the user's name is shown in the navigation.

cases.title: Sign in with wrong password
cases.preconditions: A registered customer account exists with a known email. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the registered email in the email field.
Enter an incorrect password in the password field.
cases.expected: An error message appears and the user remains on the login page (exact message text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Submit login form with both fields empty
cases.preconditions: The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
cases.expected: A required-field validation message is shown for the email field and a required-field validation message is shown for the password field (exact message text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Submit login form with only the password field empty
cases.preconditions: A registered customer account exists with a known email. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the registered email in the email field.
cases.expected: A required-field validation message is shown for the empty password field (exact message text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Submit login form with only the email field empty
cases.preconditions: The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter any password in the password field.
cases.expected: A required-field validation message is shown for the empty email field (exact message text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Password field masks typed characters
cases.preconditions: The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Type a password of several characters.
Observe the characters displayed in the password field.
cases.expected: The typed characters are masked and not shown as readable text.
